evidence: at least four clean ones delivered as 32 clean fixtures (C-001..C-032) across 42 files and sixteen languages/formats (Python, TypeScript, TSX, JavaScript, Go, Java, Apex, HCL, Kubernetes YAML, GitHub Actions YAML, Gradle Groovy, Android XML, Salesforce object metadata, LWC HTML, JSON, npmrc). Every fixture pattern-matches as vulnerable and is not; each row in fixtures/clean/EXPECTED-clean.md names the sweep that fires and the discriminator that clears it

Every bullet in a lens's Known false positives section is backed by a case in fixtures/clean/ — delivered partially and measured rather than claimed: 75 of the 98 numbered entries across all fourteen lenses are exercised, with a per-lens table and a stated reason for each of the 23 that are not. Five lenses reach full coverage (cloud-and-iac, crypto-and-key-management, hipaa-and-phi, mobile-app-security, web-and-api)

The design says every false-positive bullet is backed by a clean case. Fourteen entries cannot be: attack-chaining (all six), completeness (3-7) and threat-modeling (2-4) take findings records and a file map as their subject, not source text, so a source fixture is the wrong instrument. One more, salesforce-platform (1), is incompatible with the zero-Low rule because the entry's own text grades the cleared shape "at most Low". Recorded as a Phase B records-fixture decision rather than satisfied with a fixture that does not exercise the entry

Running it against each fixtures/clean/ case reports zero findings at Low severity or above recorded as the manifest's stated expectation for all 32 rows, with Info explicitly allowed because Info is not a vulnerability claim

The punch list requires "every clean file is self-contained — a reviewer holding only that one file must be able to reach no finding". Four fixtures cannot satisfy that literally, because the false-positive entry they exercise requires a discriminator that lives in a second artifact by construction: mobile-app-security (5) demands the release variant's android:debuggable, salesforce-platform (2) demands the object's sharingModel, ai-generated-code (12) accepts a linguist-generated attribute, and cicd-and-supply-chain (5) distinguishes library from application by manifest evidence. Those four ship as small multi-file fixture sets (C-006 five files, C-015 two, C-023 two, C-025 two) with the coupling named in each header, rather than as single files that ask the reader to assume the discriminator
